title: Cognyte Expands Military Footprint with $20+ Million Framework Agreement with Tier-1 Ministry of Defense
summary: Established with the ministry's procurement authority, the agreement sets predefined terms for solutions across Cognyte's investigative analytics portfolio.
body_markdown:
**HERZLIYA, Israel, October 21, 2026** –[Cognyte Software Ltd](https://www.cognyte.com/) . (NASDAQ: CGNT) (“Cognyte”), a global leader in AI-powered investigative analytics solutions, today announced a $20+ million framework agreement with a new Tier-1 customer, the Ministry of Defense of a NATO member nation, with an option to increase the framework agreement by up to 50 percent.


Established with the ministry’s procurement authority, the agreement sets predefined terms and conditions for solutions across Cognyte’s AI-powered investigative analytics portfolio. One agency has already placed an initial order under the agreement, and other units across the ministry can order under the same terms. This offers agencies a quick and direct route to vetted and approved solutions and gives Cognyte a pathway to broader adoption across the ministry.


Defense organizations are operating in a dynamic security environment, where securing national interests depends on understanding threats early and acting with confidence. Intelligence data is growing in volume and complexity, and military agencies are actively enhancing their intelligence capabilities to ensure they remain self-sufficient and ahead of ever-evolving threats. Framework agreements allow defense ministries to set commercial and delivery terms in advance, so agencies can quickly deploy new solutions from trusted partners as their requirements evolve.


“This award followed an extensive competitive evaluation and multiple proofs of concept, where our technology demonstrated the performance required for mission-critical defense operations,” said Adam Philpott, Chief Revenue Officer at Cognyte. “The initial order reflects the customer’s confidence in Cognyte and establishes a strong foundation for broader adoption across the ministry.”


“Military intelligence is a growth priority for Cognyte, and this agreement demonstrates our execution against that strategy,” said David Abadi, Chief Financial Officer at Cognyte. “With more than $10 million already ordered and a clear path to broader adoption across the ministry, it provides growth potential and greater visibility into future business.”


**About Cognyte**


Cognyte is a global leader in AI-powered investigative analytics solutions that empower customers with Actionable Intelligence for a Safer World®. Cognyte’s solutions enable law enforcement, national security and military intelligence agencies, as well as other organizations, to navigate an increasingly complex threat landscape. With offerings that leverage advanced technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI) and analytics, Cognyte helps customers make sense of growing volumes of fragmented multi-source data to help identify, assess, and mitigate risks across dynamic environments, supporting informed, mission-critical investigations and operations. Hundreds of customers worldwide rely on Cognyte’s intelligence platform to uncover insights and reveal what matters, enabling confident decision-making in high-stakes environments. Learn more at **[www.cognyte.com](https://www.cognyte.com/) .**
